Wonderful experience with Dr Nicha. Had X-rays, exam and cleaning. The dentist cleaned my teeth. She took the time to answer my questions and gave me a good summary of my dental health. I have met some dentists who are more transactional in the services, but not Dr Nicha. She is the type of dentist I have been looking for!  With excellent English skills, she is very easy to understand so expats and travelers like myself will feel very comfortable. I definitely recommend her services.

Office is convenient to Chong Nonsi station off of Silom BTS line. The office is clean and comfortable. And lastly her front office staff and also her assistant were both friendly and treated me with care.
